card.name: Coma in sedation warning lists
card.fires_on: The word coma in the list 'profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death'. This is the standard warning about combining opioids or benzodiazepines with other CNS depressants.

modes.label: Coma in CNS depressant warning
modes.description: The word coma, third in the list after sedation and respiratory depression and before 'and death'.
modes.example: including alcohol, may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression,<< coma>>, and death. Reserve concomitant

card.plain: It lights up on the word coma in the familiar warning that sedation, slowed breathing, coma and death can follow combining sedating drugs.
